description:
Deprecated, use [ Field schemes](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-field-schemes/#api-group-field-schemes) which supports field association schemes.

Creates a field configuration scheme.

This operation can only create field configuration schemes used in company-managed (classic) projects.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

example.description: We can use this one for software projects.
example.name: Field Configuration Scheme for software related projects

requestBody.description: The details of the field configuration scheme.

application/json.example: {"description":"We can use this one for software projects.","id":"10002","name":"Field Configuration Scheme for software related projects"}

201.description: Returned if the request is successful.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["A field configuration scheme is using this name."],"errors":{}}

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["Only Jira administrators can access field configurations."],"errors":{}}

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the necessary permissions.
